name: Baseline Integrity
description: A Baselined Deliverable's content must match its last approved snapshot exactly, and every divergence must be attributable to an approved change.

conditions.statement: The Deliverable's current content hash matches its recorded baseline hash, or the divergence is attributed to exactly one approved Change record.

requiredEvidence.title: Baseline Hash Comparison

conditions.statement: No commit to the baselined branch lacks an associated Change ID.
